$comment: Editorial data the generator cannot derive from the schemas: one-line summaries, the defining specification and section, and the vocabulary term meanings. The conformance profile is DERIVED from the schema title, never stored here. Everything else — schema files, digests, registries, type pages — is generated from rltp-spec by scripts/generate.mjs, which FAILS if a shipped type has no entry here or an entry has no shipped type.
framework: ToIP DTGWG Trust Tasks 0.4 (draft), §6.5 private specifications
offlineRule: Conforming implementations pre-register every schema by its $id and never resolve schemas or contexts over the network at runtime; this registry is documentation and distribution, not runtime infrastructure.

encounter-bundle/0.1.summary: The one-scan transmission: the scanner's sent card and step credential.

delivery-ack/0.1.summary: The arrival acknowledgement: proof-carrying, terminal, arrival-only semantics.

encounter-credential-delivery/0.1.summary: Post-enactment delivery of a step credential (counter-step or standalone).

access-operation/0.1.summary: The generic carrier for Access-layer operations crossing the replica boundary, incl. the member.add admission profile and the welcome seal.

membership-invite/0.1.summary: The invitation: no key material, invitee signed into the payload, inviter card and validity window.

membership-accept/0.1.summary: The consent artifact: signed by the person consenting, content-bound to exactly one invitation.

membership-evidence/0.1.summary: The evidence relay: the complete invite and accept documents, enclosed, so any authorized member can admit.

key-delivery/0.1.summary: Epoch key material to a specific party, and the authenticated request for it: transition key envelopes, welcomes and re-welcomes, refreshes under the key service duty.

removal-notice/0.1.summary: The compact notice a removed member is owed: it states the removal without carrying the transition-bearing envelope, which never crosses the replica boundary.

terms.meaning: the stable Layer-1 identifier of a person (in the interim profile: a did:key)
a person's signed self-description: verification material, key-agreement key, challenge when used in an enactment
a fresh, single-use, high-entropy value carried in a contact card for one enactment; governed by the own-challenge state model
a registered, versioned definition of an encounter interaction, including its time parameters
one performed run of a ceremony between two people; never reused
one credential issuance within an enactment
the digest, identical in both step credentials, tying them to one exchange descriptor
the immutable credential in which one party records that they recognized another
the multibase multihash over JCS(document) of the complete credential including its proof
the relation between two anchors constituted by the encounter credentials between them: incoming, outgoing, or mutual; one edge per anchor pair
the multibase multihash over JCS(document) of a delivery document's plaintext; its identity for idempotency and acknowledgement
the encrypted form in which a document travels: ephemeral X25519, HKDF, AES-256-GCM
the receiver's classification of a processed envelope (staged, first failing stage names it)
the arrival acknowledgement: machine-generated at the durable recording of a document's defined effect; arrival, never acceptance

vocabularyOfflineRule: Per the interim securing profile, credentials pin their @context by value and implementations never process JSON-LD or resolve schemas over the network at runtime; this registry is documentation and distribution, not runtime infrastructure.
